summary: Built semantic_judgments for the single accepted cover unit. The cover is a terminal fixed cover layout: university name, document type, location, and various format/style notes are fixed school content; the Chinese and English titles, student name, student ID, grade/major/class composite, advisor name and title, department, and submission date are fill_slots bound to vocabulary fields. The preceding 附件1 封面基本格式 preamble sits outside the visible cover outline per the runtime checkpoint and is treated as template-note text to be cleaned.

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中论文不要。

semantic_judgments.reason: Per runtime checkpoint, the 附件1 封面基本格式 paragraph is a format/style preamble that sits outside the visible cover text outline. Its format and edge-margin obligations belong to post-unit style handling; the prose itself is template-note text and should not appear in the filled cover.
Pure formatting note indicating one empty line of vertical space; no fill value or fixed label content.

parts.text: 湖 南 农 业 大学

semantic_judgments.reason: University name is fixed school content shown on every cover; the parenthetical is a font/weight requirement, not a value placeholder. The trailing "（一号华文行楷加粗）" note is style context.

parts.text: 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计)

semantic_judgments.reason: Document type line is fixed school content; the parenthetical is a font/weight requirement. The conditional design/paper phrasing from the preamble is already encoded in the literal text here.

parts.text: 毕业论文（设计）中文题目

semantic_judgments.reason: This line occupies the Chinese title slot on the cover. The textual prefix "毕业论文（设计）中文题目" sits in the value position that the actual Chinese thesis title replaces; per the template-text-classification guidance, a value-position line that names the field behaves as a fill_slot. thesis.title.zh in vocabulary allows fill_slot role. The parenthetical is a font/weight style requirement.
The English title line sits in the value position of the English thesis title on the cover; thesis.title.en allows fill_slot. The parenthetical encodes font, weight, and capitalization requirements.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Style note describing vertical spacing dependent on title length.

Student name row. The label "□□□□□□学生姓名" and trailing colon stay as fixed labels; "（三号黑体加粗）" is a font/weight requirement for the label; the value placeholder "×××（或×□×）" occupies the value slot for author.name.zh; the trailing "（三号楷体加粗）" sets the value-area font/weight. The parentheses inside the value placeholder are template guidance for name length and not part of the displayed value.
Student ID row. Leading indent and "学□□号：" label, including inline spacing inside the label word, stay fixed; the placeholder digits occupy the value slot for author.student_id.

Composite grade/major/class row. The vocabulary provides author.cohort_class as a single composite fill value exactly matching the school pattern of "年级、专业及班级复合信息"; the whole "20××级×××（×）班" placeholder is one composite value. Inner parentheses are class-count guidance, not literal text.

Advisor row carries two distinct values: advisor name and advisor title. Vocabulary has both fields with allowed_part_roles including fill_slot. The "□" between them is intra-value spacing; treated as style_only because it does not carry any semantic label or value. Note the field-meaning note that advisor title should not be auto-filled without a source — the placeholder "教授" stays as the field slot, to be replaced by the student-supplied title.
Department row. Label and colon stay fixed; placeholder "××××学院" is the value for author.department; trailing parenthetical is a naming-requirement style note.
Style-only spacing note before the location line.
Fixed school location line; the parenthetical sets the font/size requirement.
Submission date row. Label "提交日期：" stays fixed; the "20××年××月" placeholder is the value slot for submission.date.
